description: Your lab has accumulated 20 systems research papers in a 'Reading Queue' collection. Some are already marked as priority reads. Before the review cycle begins, you need to triage the priority papers by era: papers tagged 'priority' that were published before 2010 should additionally be tagged 'review-now' (these are foundational works requiring urgent attention), while priority papers from 2010 onwards should be tagged 'review-later'. Non-priority papers should not receive either tag. Once your triage tags are applied, create a saved search named exactly 'Review Now' that automatically collects all items tagged 'review-now'. Finally, export the results of that saved search as BibTeX to /home/ga/Desktop/review_now.bib.

priority_papers_pre2010: Chord: A Scalable Peer-to-peer Lookup Service for Internet Applications
priority_papers_post2010: Raft: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
TiKV: A Distributed Transactional Key-Value Database
